name: Wifi symbol
summary: Generic wireless signal icon: a dot with three arcs that light up in turn; use for connectivity and internet scenes.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x of the dot; floats, no ground

params.name: y
params.note: centre y of the dot; the symbol floats around this point

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the symbol is about 540 px across

params.name: color
params.note: lit colour of the dot and arcs

params.name: off
params.note: colour of arcs that are not lit

params.name: anim
params.note: signal = arcs light up in turn, inner to outer

author: krakujs
